# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 25 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Makes the Tablets

---

**1** Seth did as his mother Eve had commanded. He made tablets of stone and clay and inscribed on them all the deeds of his father and mother.

**2** Seth was a righteous man who feared God all his life and followed in all the ways of his father Adam.

**3** After Eve's death, Seth continued to live and multiply, filling the earth.

**4** Seth lived nine hundred and twelve years.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
